edges.label: F1 files, mappings, intent, patches, approval [keyboard, file picker; Confidential]
F2 pages and /v1 calls: upload, jobs, drafts, patches, preview, approve [HTTPS, session; Confidential]
F3 the same, forwarded with a request id [HTTP in the VPC, session cookie; Confidential]
F4 the original, streamed under the organization's prefix [HTTPS, SigV4, SSE-KMS; Confidential]
F5 import and generation jobs, drafts, patch revisions, preview records [TLS, role workspace; Confidential]
F6 claimed import job: source id, limits, format [TLS, role worker, via the worker; Internal]
F7 original bytes, piped in by the host [HTTPS, SigV4, SSE-KMS; Confidential]
F8 Parquet revision, piped out, written by the host [HTTPS, SigV4, SSE-KMS; Confidential]
F9 job done or refused: schema, counts, suggested mappings, reason [TLS, role worker; Internal]
F10 nearest catalog entries and curated examples [in process; Internal]
F11 claimed generation job: intent, retrieval labels, authorized schemas [TLS, role worker; Confidential]
F12 intent, schemas, catalog metadata, synthetic rows, no evidence [HTTPS, API key; Confidential]
F13 proposed AppDefinition, untrusted until admitted [HTTPS, API key; Internal]
F14 draft revision with its labels, or failed after two attempts [TLS, role worker; Internal]
F15 admit a draft digest, submit, approve a digest, publish [HTTP, service token; Internal]
F16 admission result, policy read, publication record, audit event [TLS, role control; Internal]
F17 admission report, publication id and digest, or the refusing rule [HTTP, service token; Internal]
F18 pages, job state, preview props, diffs, inbox [HTTPS, session; Confidential]
F19 the same, no-store [HTTPS, session; Confidential]
F20 publication event: the organization's catalog [TLS, role worker; Internal]
F21 index files rebuilt for the organization [HTTPS, SigV4, SSE-KMS; Confidential]

boundaries.label: Parser sandbox: WebAssembly, no system interface
Workers: the only egress to the model provider
Control plane: the only writer of publications
The VPC: the edge, the workspace server and the stores
